def.brief: Owner-authorized environment maintenance, session-owned: released hunsu 1.15.1 judge consume, on a still-fits verdict, replaces an existing explicit reviewed:false resolution with a delegated-judge object, silently removing unread-review debt (root's inspection; hunsu's own source session fixes it for its next release). Restore reviewed:false for each of the four resolutions that were false before the refresh (captured outside this project) wherever consume changed it, keeping order/accept/note and everything else; no judge request, no model call, no change to the raw judge answers or to hunsu-judgments.json; then the supported lock and check. Finding at start: the only resolution consume changed ('testing or trying a built slice') was already restored to false in g-env-refresh before its commit, so hunsu.json and hunsu.lock.json already hold all four as false and match their committed text; this task verifies that, re-runs lock/check, and records the limitation. The four stay unread: nobody is recorded as having read them.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so
h-review-debt: done on the session's word by name (`run h-review-debt`), with nothing of its own in the tree and no `did`

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
